notes.title: 0.7.10PT
notes.content:
✨New Playtest update is live! ✨ 

[list]
[*]Fixed Printer Boss's ink blobs not disappearing
[*]Readded basic, rare and ultra rare material drops
[*]Some refactoring done to optimize the game further
[/list]

As always, don't forget to give feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/hyesmo]Discord[/url] or via the feedback form in game. Have fun!

notes.title: Just a small fix, version didn't change
notes.content:
Fixed the FoW on Floor 7(2 floors after the boss). Thanks Beck!

Current known bugs:
-Can't earn weapon unlock currency - acknowledged
-Boss' attack telegraphs doesn't clear properly - working on it

You can track what's going on and bug report @ [url=https://discord.gg/hyesmo]Discord[/url]
(beck posted the bug on discord and i immediately took action. it seems fair to join discord. please join discord...)

notes.title: Patch 0.7.9PT
notes.content:
This patch is the closest that'll be to the EA build.

There'll be additions and also, removals. For example, the affix pool will decrease drastically. In the other hand, next boss is cooking. Ehhhh.... I don't know what else to say... Hope you enjoy it and please please please fill the feedback form in the main menu(it'll forward you to google forms)
